faq.q: What is Mount Kalaga National Park in GTA 6?
faq.a: Mount Kalaga National Park is an officially named destination in Grand Theft Auto VI, representing a national park within Leonida. Rockstar's official screenshot library provides six images labeled for it, and the artwork collection includes a matching postcard.

faq.q: Is Mount Kalaga National Park based on a real place in Florida?
faq.a: No direct one-to-one match. According to the record, real-world Florida has no single location called Mount Kalaga, so the name and setting in GTA 6 are fictional.

faq.q: What kind of environment does Mount Kalaga National Park represent?
faq.a: The park establishes GTA 6's northern wilderness and outdoor environment, distinguishing it from the urban and coastal environments shown elsewhere in Leonida.

faq.q: When was Mount Kalaga National Park revealed?
faq.a: Mount Kalaga National Park first appeared in Trailer 2, released on 6 May 2025.
